title: ditassa jahnii
intro: Ditassa jahnii, commonly known as the Jahn's Ditassa, is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. It is traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include relieving fever, colds, and respiratory issues due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Ditassa jahnii include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help in soothing coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Ditassa jahnii include alkaloids and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
